content.short: Ton Vote is an on-chain governance platform for TON, enabling transparent and secure community voting.
content.description: Ton Vote is a specialized decentralized governance platform designed for the TON ecosystem, functioning similarly to Snapshot. It enables projects, DAOs, and communities on TON to conduct transparent, on-chain voting processes where token holders can influence the direction of their favorite protocols. By providing a secure and verifiable way to gauge community sentiment, Ton Vote promotes decentralization and active participation, ensuring that governance decisions are made fairly and recorded permanently on the blockchain.
content.meta: Participate in TON governance with Ton Vote. Secure on-chain voting for DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
